Date: 2026-11-01T09:18:00-08:00

Hi Maya — thanks for sending this over. Quick follow-up from our side so we can schedule payment:

- Can you confirm whether Auragrow will pay by ACH (USD), wire, or virtual card?
- If wire, please confirm beneficiary details on the attached wire template (we may need bank name + beneficiary VAT/ID for our finance team).
- We have PO 2937 on file but line items don’t map exactly to the invoice; I attached our PO for cross-check. If there’s a PO mismatch please advise.

If it helps speed things up, we can accept a one-time virtual card charge today (no change to invoice) and Auragrow can follow up with VAT documentation next week — finance is willing to take that route if it’s easier for AP.

Attachments: redwood_po_2937.pdf; wire_instructions.docx (template)

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD Tuesday so we can hit the month-end run?

Diego Fernandez
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Invoice 2026-214: Payment path decision needed

Diego / Ben — quick internal note before we hear back from Maya:

- If Auragrow opts for virtual card, we can process today and clear the invoice in this month’s sweep. That avoids chasing VAT docs immediately and is acceptable for this one-off.
- If they insist on wire/ACH, we should request remittance with beneficiary VAT ID and their bank confirmation — that typically adds 2–3 business days.
- Given the PO mismatch, recommend we approve card by default and reconcile once VAT docs arrive. Ben, any objections on reserving the card option for collections?

Marissa
Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@auragrow.com>

Hi all — thanks for the follow ups and the PO copy. We can do a wire for this invoice; AP will initiate wire on 2026-11-12 morning (EST).

Action items on our side:
- Wire will be sent 11/12; I’ll reply with a bank confirmation/trace number once initiated.
- VAT attestation requested: we are still pulling our local VAT registration proof and will send by 2026-11-16 at the latest.
- PO mismatch: internal note — line 3 had a separate SOW code. I’ve copied procurement to reconcile, but payment will not be delayed for that.

Attachments: remittance_receipt_placeholder.pdf (will be replaced with actual trace once wire sent)
